mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, directly causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) triggers Fed tightening expectations, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.3%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL monthly change against 20-day SPX returns is greater than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by >0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) against 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), low unemployment supports wage growth and corporate profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE against 20-day SPX returns is greater than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average reflects strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC for INDPRO against 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1500.0 thousand units) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced construction sector activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST against 5-day SPX returns is greater than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and high CPIAUCSL (above 270) signal Fed response to inflation, supporting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through policy accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 270, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) against 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%) leads to profit-taking and reduced risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through market overvaluation.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 annual growth against 5-day SPX returns is greater than -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
